record.title: Norway prohibits ordinary entry through minor Innlandet–Sweden crossings
record.scope: Route-use prohibition; initially legal rather than physical barricade
record.crossings: Selected minor Innlandet–Sweden crossings, including Mitandersfors; permitted-route roster changed and January reporting includes Linna as well as Støa, Riksåsen and Magnormoen.
record.exceptions: Outbound movement; goods transport, commuters and critical functions
record.imposing_authority: Norwegian government and Innlandet Police District
record.enforcement: Crossing was legally prohibited for non-exempt entrants; initial report expressly says physical barriers absent.
record.relationship: Route geography differs from nationality-based EU022/R3-EU-001; overlapping2021 regime, not additive border-wide closure.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status extrapolation to 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Channel arrivals through testing/police posts to limit imported infection.
record.context: Channel arrivals through testing/police posts to limit imported infection.
record.uncertainty: Specific route permissions changed during2021. October is national announced removal of remaining post restrictions, not proof every Innlandet route stayed closed throughout.

historical.duration_note: Scheduled or ordered reopening; actual operational duration not established. No operational duration inferred from a legal endpoint or mixed phases.
